cases.description: Every clause matches, reworded. Baseline: no false alarms.

limitation_of_liability.evidence: Neither party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement will exceed the total amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve (12) month period preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

auto_renewal.evidence: Provider will notify Customer in writing no less than sixty (60) days prior to each renewal date, and Customer may elect not to renew by giving written notice at any time before the renewal date.

payment_terms.evidence: Customer will pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after receipt.

termination_for_convenience.evidence: Customer may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
